chapter: 占疾病第二十四(鬼谷辨爻法、孙膑断疾病歌、经验论家人占病)
chapter_en: Section 24, on illness (Guigu's table, Sun Bin's song, verses on family members)

units.chapter: 占疾病第二十四·鬼谷辨爻法
units.chapter_en: Section 24, on illness: Guigu's method of telling the lines apart
units.title: 鬼谷辨爻法·占疾病：初爻足、二爻腿股、三爻腰、四爻脊、五爻心、六爻头

rule.yi: 鬼谷子辨爻法在占疾病一章的表：初爻管足，二爻管腿和股，三爻管腰，四爻管脊，五爻管心，六爻管头。表的第一行另有丧门、吊客、哭声、棺木、行兆、坟墓六个名目，按六列的次序对着初爻到六爻。
rule.en: Guigu's table of the lines for the chapter on illness: the first line governs the feet, the second the legs and thighs, the third the waist, the fourth the spine, the fifth the heart and the sixth the head. The table's first row also gives six names, Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, weeping, the coffin, Xingzhao and the grave, which by the order of the six columns stand over the first to the sixth lines.

zh: 丧门吊客哭声棺木行兆坟墓
初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
yi: 鬼谷子辨别各爻的办法
丧门、吊客、哭声、棺木、行兆、坟墓（六个名目）
初爻、二爻、三爻、四爻、五爻、六爻
en: Guigu's method of telling the lines apart
Mourning Gate, Guest of Condolence, weeping, the coffin, Xingzhao and the grave (six names)
the first, second, third, fourth, fifth and sixth lines
the feet, the legs and thighs, the waist, the spine, the heart, the head

dispute.yi: 哪一爻管身体哪一处，几本书差得很远。这张表是「初足、二腿股、三腰、四脊、五心、六头」；同一章孙膑断疾病歌（LY.ILL.DYTJ.03）是「一五脏、二皮肉、三体骨腰并足、四肺心经、五六头」，和阐奥歌章（LY.ILL.CA.04）同；同一章卜筮元龟一段（LY.ILL.DYTJ.11）是「初两足、二双腿、三腰背、四心腹肚肠、五肾脏、六头」；易隐引鬼谷分爻（LY.ILL.YY.02）是「初足、二腿股、三肝肾、四脾脏、五心肺、六头脑」。头在六爻、足在初爻，几家一致；中间三爻各说各的。同一本书里，鬼谷辨爻法的表和孙膑歌就对不上。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Which line governs which part of the body is put very differently in several books. This table has 'first the feet, second the legs and thighs, third the waist, fourth the spine, fifth the heart, sixth the head'; Sun Bin's song in the same chapter (LY.ILL.DYTJ.03) has 'the first the five viscera, the second skin and flesh, the third body, bones, waist and feet, the fourth lungs and heart channel, the fifth and sixth the head', as in the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.04); the Bushi Yuangui passage in the same chapter (LY.ILL.DYTJ.11) has 'first the two feet, second both legs, third waist and back, fourth heart, belly and bowels, fifth the kidneys, sixth the head'; and the Yi Yin, quoting Guigu's division of the lines (LY.ILL.YY.02), has 'first the feet, second the legs and thighs, third liver and kidneys, fourth the spleen, fifth heart and lungs, sixth the head and brain'. The head at the sixth line and the feet at the first are agreed; the three lines between are put differently in each. Even within this one book the table under Guigu's name and Sun Bin's song do not agree. The books do not settle it.

note.yi: 这是一张三行的表，原书排成六列：第一行六个名目，第二行初爻到六爻，第三行六个部位。第一行在原文里连着写、没有标点，这里按六列的次序把丧门配初爻、吊客配二爻、哭声配三爻、棺木配四爻、行兆配五爻、坟墓配六爻；这是照表的列序读的，书里没有另写解释。「行兆」的意思书里没有说，「兆」有墓地的意思，可能是出殡去墓地的行列，这里不能确定，英文只给拼音。同一书的每一章开头都有一张「鬼谷辨爻法」的表，占六畜章那张是初爻鸡鸭、二爻猫犬、三爻猪、四爻羊、五爻牛、六爻马，所以这一行是把六个爻位配给这一章要看的东西。
note.en: This is a table of three rows, laid out in the book as six columns: the first row six names, the second the first to sixth lines, the third six parts of the body. The first row is written in the original run together without punctuation; here Mourning Gate is taken with the first line, Guest of Condolence with the second, weeping with the third, the coffin with the fourth, Xingzhao with the fifth and the grave with the sixth, which is reading by the order of the columns, and the book does not explain it separately. The book does not say what 'Xingzhao' means; 'zhao' can mean a burial ground and it may be the procession to the grave, but this cannot be settled here, so the English gives only the pinyin. Every chapter of this book opens with a table headed 'Guigu's method of telling the lines apart'; the one for the chapter on livestock runs first line fowl, second cats and dogs, third pigs, fourth sheep, fifth cattle, sixth horses, so this row assigns the six line positions to what that chapter is about.

units.chapter: 占疾病第二十四·孙膑断疾病歌
units.chapter_en: Section 24, on illness: Sun Bin's song on judging illness
units.title: 孙膑断疾病歌(一)：凡占疾病先从卦中寻本命、仍看来占是何人；福德持世鬼暂退、爻旺之日又加进；卦中无鬼病难医、鬼旺财兴命难保；鬼煞临身五墓加、鬼神休祷药无灵

rule.yi: 占疾病，先在卦里找出病人的本命爻，再看来占的是什么人；福德持世，鬼暂时退去，可是爻旺的日子又进一步；卦里没有鬼，病难医；鬼旺、财兴，命难保；鬼煞临在身上又加了五墓，向鬼神祷告也不必了，药也无灵。
rule.en: In divining illness, first find the sick person's natal line in the hexagram and look at who has come to divine. With Output holding the Self the ghost retreats for a time, but on a day when the line is strong it advances again. With no ghost in the hexagram the illness is hard to treat; with the ghost strong and Wealth rising life is hard to keep. A ghost-killing sitting on the Body with the Five Tombs added: there is no use praying to ghosts and spirits, and medicine has no effect.

yi: 还要看来占的是什么人，
克它的是什么、加在世应上。
鬼煞临在身上，又加了五墓，
向鬼神祷告也不必了，药也无灵。
en: If someone divines an illness,
first look in the hexagram for the natal line,
and still look at who it is that has come to divine,
and what it is that controls, added to the Self and Other.
Output holding the Self: the ghost retreats for a time;
on a day when the line is strong it advances again;
with no ghost in the hexagram the illness is hard to treat;
with the ghost strong and Wealth rising, life is hard to keep.
a ghost-killing sitting on the Body with the Five Tombs added:
there is no use praying to ghosts and spirits, and medicine has no effect.

note.yi: 这是孙膑断疾病歌的头十句。前面几句和阐奥歌章的第二首疾病歌（LY.ILL.CA.04）几乎一样，只有几处用字不同：阐奥歌章是「官旺之日又加进」，这里是「爻旺之日又加进」；阐奥歌章是「鬼旺财兴难保命」，这里是「鬼旺财兴命难保」；阐奥歌章是「鬼杀临身五墓侵、鬼神不应药无灵」，这里是「鬼煞临身五墓加、鬼神休祷药无灵」。「爻旺之日」的「爻」，照阐奥歌章同一句读作鬼爻。「本命」是病人的本命爻（生年属相所在的爻）。「鬼煞临身五墓加」后面的「（1）」是今人加的注号，那条注不收；五墓的排法（春未、夏戌、秋丑、冬辰）见 LY.ILL.EL.51。「休祷」按「不必祷告」译。
note.en: These are the first ten lines of Sun Bin's song on judging illness. The first lines are almost the same as the second illness poem of the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.04), with a few differences in wording: the Chan'ao Gezhang has 'on a day when the Pressure line is strong it advances again' where this has 'on a day when the line is strong'; it has 'ghost strong and Wealth rising, hard to keep life' where this has 'life is hard to keep'; and it has 'a ghost-killing on the Body and the Five Tombs invading, the ghosts and spirits do not respond and medicine has no effect' where this has 'the Five Tombs added, no use praying to ghosts and spirits, medicine has no effect'. The 'line' of 'on a day when the line is strong' is read as the Pressure line, following the same line in the Chan'ao Gezhang. The 'natal line' is the sick person's natal line (the line where the birth animal falls). The '(1)' after 'the Five Tombs added' is a modern annotation mark and that annotation is not quoted; for how the Five Tombs are laid out (Wei in spring, Xu in summer, Chou in autumn, Chen in winter) see LY.ILL.EL.51. 'Xiu dao' is rendered 'no use praying'.

units.chapter: 占疾病第二十四·孙膑断疾病歌
units.chapter_en: Section 24, on illness: Sun Bin's song on judging illness
units.title: 孙膑断疾病歌(二)：一爻五脏、二皮肉、三体骨腰并足、四肺心经、五六头；游魂恍惚如神触、归魂渐向安；乾首坤腹、坎耳震足巽肠、艮手兑口离目，鬼在其中即患伤

rule.yi: 一爻管五脏，二爻管皮肉，三爻管体骨、腰和足，四爻管肺和心经，五、六爻管头。游魂卦人恍惚，像被神鬼触到；只有归魂卦渐渐向安。再看八卦：乾是头，坤是腹，坎是耳，震是足，巽是肠，艮是手，兑是口，离是目；鬼在哪一卦里，那一处就生病受伤，时下的术士要仔细推它落在哪里。
rule.en: The first line governs the five viscera, the second skin and flesh, the third body, bones, waist and feet, the fourth the lungs and heart channel, the fifth and sixth the head. In a Wandering Soul hexagram the person is dazed, as if touched by spirits; only a Returning Soul hexagram gradually turns to peace. Then the trigrams: Qian the head, Kun the belly, Kan the ears, Zhen the feet, Xun the bowels, Gen the hands, Dui the mouth and Li the eyes; whichever of them the ghost is in, that part is ill and injured, and the diviners of the day must carefully work out where it comes to rest.

yi: 第一爻是五脏，第二爻是皮肉，
第四爻是肺和心经，第五、第六爻是头；
游魂卦恍惚，像被神鬼触到；
坎是耳、震是足，再加巽是肠，
艮是手、兑是口，再加离是目；
鬼在哪一卦里，那一处就生病受伤，
时下的术士要仔细推它落在哪里。
en: the first line is the five viscera, the second skin and flesh,
the third body, bones, waist and feet;
the fourth is the lungs and heart channel, the fifth and sixth the head;
the Wandering Soul hexagram: dazed, as if touched by spirits;
only the Returning Soul gradually turns to peace;
look further: Qian is the head and Kun the belly,
Kan the ears, Zhen the feet and Xun the bowels,
Gen the hands, Dui the mouth and Li the eyes;
the ghost being in one of them, that part is ill and injured,
and the diviners of the day must carefully work out where it comes to rest.

dispute.yi: 八卦各管身体哪一处，几处说法不同。孙膑歌这里是「乾首、坤腹、坎耳、震足、巽肠、艮手、兑口、离目」；阐奥歌章（LY.ILL.CA.02）是巽手、艮鼻，其余同；同一章卜筮元龟一段（LY.ILL.DYTJ.12）是巽股、艮手；卜筮正宗痘疹章（LY.ILL.BSZZ.23）也是巽股、艮手。乾首、坤腹、坎耳、离目、兑口、震足几家一致；巽有手、肠、股三说，艮有鼻、手两说。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Which part of the body each of the eight trigrams governs is put differently in several places. Here Sun Bin's song has 'Qian the head, Kun the belly, Kan the ears, Zhen the feet, Xun the bowels, Gen the hands, Dui the mouth, Li the eyes'; the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.02) has Xun the hands and Gen the nose, the rest the same; the Bushi Yuangui passage in the same chapter (LY.ILL.DYTJ.12) has Xun the thighs and Gen the hands; and the smallpox chapter of the Bushi Zhengzong (LY.ILL.BSZZ.23) likewise has Xun the thighs and Gen the hands. Qian the head, Kun the belly, Kan the ears, Li the eyes, Dui the mouth and Zhen the feet are agreed; Xun has three readings (hands, bowels, thighs) and Gen two (nose, hands). The books do not settle it.

note.yi: 头三句和阐奥歌章的第二首疾病歌（LY.ILL.CA.04）一字不差。「游魂」「归魂」是卦的名称（游魂卦、归魂卦），「恍惚」是神志不清。「时师」按「时下的术士」译。这里的八卦部位是乾头、坤腹、坎耳、震足、巽肠、艮手、兑口、离目，巽配的是肠；别处巽配手或配股，见「打架」。
note.en: The first three lines are word for word the same as the second illness poem of the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.04). 'Wandering Soul' and 'Returning Soul' are names of hexagrams (the Wandering Soul hexagram and the Returning Soul hexagram), and 'dazed' is clouded consciousness. 'Shi shi' is rendered 'the diviners of the day'. The trigram parts here are Qian the head, Kun the belly, Kan the ears, Zhen the feet, Xun the bowels, Gen the hands, Dui the mouth and Li the eyes, with Xun matched to the bowels; elsewhere Xun is matched to the hands or the thighs, see the dispute.

units.chapter: 占疾病第二十四·孙膑断疾病歌
units.chapter_en: Section 24, on illness: Sun Bin's song on judging illness
units.title: 孙膑断疾病歌(三)：木主酸痛火主疮、水土虚黄并肿毒、金为牙齿痛非常；外克内应克世有药频频泻肚肠、内克外世克应无鬼爻多呕吐伤；更看五鬼配五脏病源有短长

rule.yi: 木主酸痛，火主疮，水和土主虚黄和肿毒，金是牙齿痛得厉害，务必仔细推详。外卦克内卦、应克世，有药也频频泻肚肠；内卦克外卦、世克应，没有鬼爻的话多是呕吐所伤。还要看五鬼配五脏，病源是长是短就在这里。
rule.en: Wood governs aching pain and Fire governs sores; Water and Earth govern deficiency with yellowing and swollen toxins; Metal is toothache beyond the ordinary; work it out carefully. The outer trigram controlling the inner, the Other controlling the Self: there is medicine, yet he purges from the bowels again and again; the inner controlling the outer, the Self controlling the Other: with no Pressure line it is mostly injury by vomiting. Look further at the five ghosts matched to the five viscera: there is where the source of the illness, short or long, is found.

yi: 没有鬼爻的话，多是呕吐所伤。
病源是长是短就在这里。
en: Wood governs aching pain, Fire governs sores;
Water and Earth govern deficiency with yellowing and swollen toxins;
Metal is toothache beyond the ordinary;
you must work it out carefully.
The outer trigram controlling the inner, the Other controlling the Self:
there is medicine, yet he purges from the bowels again and again;
the inner controlling the outer, the Self controlling the Other:
with no Pressure line it is mostly injury by vomiting.
Look further at the five ghosts matched to the five viscera:
there is where the source of the illness, short or long, is found.

note.yi: 「五鬼」是五行各自的鬼（金鬼、木鬼、水鬼、火鬼、土鬼）；「五鬼配五脏」是鬼属哪一行、就配哪一脏来看病源，歌里没有把配法列出来。「有药频频泻肚肠」可以读成服了药反而频频泻，也可以读成有药也止不住泻，这里按字面译。「无鬼爻多呕吐伤」是说内克外、世克应而卦里没有鬼爻时，多是呕吐；洞林秘诀一段（LY.ILL.DYTJ.16）有同样的一对：我克他先呕逆、他克我泻为伤。「虚黄」按「虚弱发黄」译。
note.en: The 'five ghosts' are the ghost of each of the five phases (the Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth ghost); 'the five ghosts matched to the five viscera' means looking at the source of the illness by which viscus the phase of the ghost matches, and the song does not list the matching. 'There is medicine, yet he purges again and again' can be read as purging the more after taking medicine, or as medicine unable to stop the purging, and it is rendered literally here. 'With no Pressure line, mostly injury by vomiting' says that when the inner controls the outer and the Self controls the Other and the hexagram has no Pressure line it is mostly vomiting; the Dongling Mijue passage (LY.ILL.DYTJ.16) has the same pair: when I control him there is vomiting first, when he controls me the purging is the harm. 'Xu huang' is rendered 'deficiency with yellowing'.

units.chapter: 占疾病第二十四·孙膑断疾病歌
units.chapter_en: Section 24, on illness: Sun Bin's song on judging illness
units.title: 孙膑断疾病歌(四)：问病须分六亲；父母空亡防父母、财爻无气损妻身、子孙化鬼须遭死、兄弟煞临定不贞

rule.yi: 问病一定要分清六亲，吉凶要弄分明。父母爻空亡，要防父母；财爻无气，损伤妻子的身体；子孙化为鬼，必定遭死；兄弟带煞临上，一定不贞。
rule.en: In asking after illness be sure to tell the six relations apart and sort out good and ill clearly. Resource Void: guard the parents; the Wealth line without qi harms the wife's person; Output changing into a ghost will meet death; a Peer with a killing sitting on it is surely not firm.

yi: 财爻无气，损伤妻子的身体；
兄弟带煞临上，一定不贞。
en: In asking after illness be sure to tell the six relations apart,
and sort out good and ill clearly.
Resource Void: guard the parents;
the Wealth line without qi harms the wife's person;
Output changing into a ghost will meet death;
a Peer with a killing sitting on it is surely not firm.

note.yi: 四句是四种人的病：占父母病看父母爻、占妻病看财爻、占子女病看子孙爻、占兄弟病看兄弟爻，和天玄赋的用爻表（LY.ILL.TXF.01）一致。「定不贞」的「贞」按字面译，意思大概是不吉，书里没有说明。
note.en: The four lines are about four kinds of person: divining a parent's illness look at the Resource line, a wife's the Wealth line, a child's the Output line and a brother's the Peer line, in agreement with the Tianxuan Fu's table of the Subject line (LY.ILL.TXF.01). The 'firm' of 'surely not firm' (zhen) is rendered literally; it probably means not auspicious, and the book does not explain it.

units.chapter: 占疾病第二十四·孙膑断疾病歌
units.chapter_en: Section 24, on illness: Sun Bin's song on judging illness
units.title: 孙膑断疾病歌(五)：明夷蛊剥夬丰同六卦占病不可逢；财鬼二爻俱发动、丧门吊客闹匆匆；六重白虎临身恶；鬼爻并爻应发动、化蛇入库身终

rule.yi: 明夷、蛊、剥、夬、丰、同这六个卦，占病时哪里愿意遇上；财、鬼两爻都发动，丧门、吊客闹哄哄地赶来；六重白虎临在身上凶恶，若在别的爻上也不好；鬼爻和应爻一起发动，化成螣蛇、入了墓库，身命就终了。
rule.en: Mingyi, Gu, Bo, Guai, Feng and Tong: who would wish to meet these six hexagrams in divining illness? With Wealth and the ghost both moving, Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence crowd in noisily and in haste; a six-fold White Tiger sitting on the Body is vicious, and if it is on another line it is also not good; the Pressure line and the Other line moving together, changing into the Coiling Snake and entering the tomb, the body's life ends.

yi: 这六个卦，占病时哪里愿意遇上；
丧门、吊客闹哄哄地赶来。
六重白虎临在身上，凶恶；
化成螣蛇、入了墓库，身命就终了。
en: Mingyi, Gu, Bo, Guai, Feng and Tong(ren):
who would wish to meet these six hexagrams in divining illness;
with Wealth and the ghost both moving,
Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence crowd in noisily and in haste.
a six-fold White Tiger sitting on the Body is vicious;
if it is on another line it is also not good;
the Pressure line and the Other line moving together,
changing into the Coiling Snake and entering the tomb, the body's life ends.

note.yi: 「同」是同人卦的简称。这六个卦和阐奥歌章、天玄赋、卜筮元龟的凶卦名单大同小异，见 LY.ILL.CA.03 的「打架」。「六卦哪须占病逢」的「哪须」，这里按「哪里愿意」译（意思是占病时不想遇上）；字面也可读成「何须」，书里没有说明。「六重白虎」字面译作 six-fold，「六重」是什么意思书里没有说。「鬼爻并爻应发动」的「并爻应」读不通顺，这里按「并应爻」译，即鬼爻和应爻一起动。「（2）」是今人的注号，那条注不收。「化蛇入库」是化成螣蛇、又入了墓库（辰戌丑未），原文没有说是什么爻。
note.en: 'Tong' is short for the Tongren hexagram. These six hexagrams are much like the lists of ominous hexagrams in the Chan'ao Gezhang, the Tianxuan Fu and the Bushi Yuangui, see the dispute in LY.ILL.CA.03. In 'who would wish to meet them in divining illness' the 'na xu' is rendered 'who would wish' (meaning one does not want to meet them in divining illness); it can also be read literally as 'why need', and the book does not explain it. 'Six-fold White Tiger' is literal, and the book does not say what 'six-fold' means. 'Gui yao bing yao ying fa dong' does not read smoothly in 'bing yao ying'; it is rendered 'bing ying yao', the Pressure line and the Other line moving together. The '(2)' is a modern annotation mark and that annotation is not quoted. 'Changing into the Snake and entering the tomb' is changing into the Coiling Snake and also entering a tomb (Chen, Xu, Chou, Wei), and the original does not say which line.

units.chapter: 占疾病第二十四·孙膑断疾病歌
units.chapter_en: Section 24, on illness: Sun Bin's song on judging illness
units.title: 孙膑断疾病歌(六)：卦变墓乡须丧命、不然亦主困蒙蒙；乾坎震巽为生魂在外不死内难存、离坤艮兑人为鬼在内定生在外死；勾陈爻动即开坟、乾兑须臾为孝子

rule.yi: 卦变到墓乡，必定丧命，不然也主昏沉困顿。乾、坎、震、巽是生魂，在外不死，在内难活；离、坤、艮、兑是人变成鬼，在内一定活，在外就死。勾陈爻动，就要开坟了；乾、兑，片刻之间就有人做孝子。孙膑这个诀很难领会，只在于善于推算。
rule.en: If the hexagram changes into the tomb quarter life will surely be lost, and otherwise it also means a dull, hazy exhaustion. Qian, Kan, Zhen and Xun are the living soul: outside he does not die, inside he can hardly survive; Li, Kun, Gen and Dui are the person becoming a ghost: inside he surely lives, outside he dies. When the Hook Earth line moves the grave is opened; Qian and Dui: in a moment someone is a filial mourner. Sun Bin's secret here is hard to know and lies only in being good at working it out.

yi: 乾、兑，片刻之间就有人做孝子。
en: If the hexagram changes into the tomb quarter life will surely be lost;
otherwise too it means a dull, hazy exhaustion;
Qian, Kan, Zhen and Xun are the living soul:
outside he does not die, inside he can hardly survive.
Li, Kun, Gen and Dui: the person becomes a ghost;
inside he surely lives, outside he dies;
when the Hook Earth line moves the grave is opened;
Qian and Dui: in a moment someone is a filial mourner.
Sun Bin's secret here is hard to know;
it lies only in being good at working it out.

note.yi: 「生魂」「鬼」是这首歌自己对八个卦的分类：乾、坎、震、巽为一类，离、坤、艮、兑为另一类；「在外」「在内」指什么，书里没有说，可能指这个卦是落在外卦还是内卦，也可能指鬼所在的位置，这里按字面译，不作选择。这套分法别的书里没有，这里只有这一首。「乾兑须臾为孝子」的「孝子」是披麻戴孝的人，也就是有人死了。「须臾」是片刻。「困蒙蒙」按「昏沉困顿」译。这一首的尾两句是收束，说孙膑的诀难懂，要靠善于推算。
note.en: 'Living soul' and 'ghost' are this song's own sorting of the eight trigrams: Qian, Kan, Zhen and Xun in one class, Li, Kun, Gen and Dui in the other. The book does not say what 'outside' and 'inside' refer to; it may be whether the trigram falls in the outer or the inner trigram of the hexagram, or the position of the ghost, and it is rendered literally here without choosing. This way of sorting is not found in the other books, only in this song. The 'filial mourner' of 'Qian and Dui in a moment a filial mourner' is a person in mourning dress, that is, someone has died. 'Xu yu' is a moment. 'Kun meng meng' is rendered 'a dull, hazy exhaustion'. The last two lines close the song, saying that Sun Bin's secret is hard to know and depends on being good at working it out.

units.chapter: 占疾病第二十四·经验论家人占病
units.chapter_en: Section 24, on illness: verses from experience on divining the illness of a family member
units.title: 经验论家人占病六首：子占父病鬼要兴隆父要安；父占子病兄兴子旺死还生；夫占妻病财明子动便安然；妻占夫病鬼静财兴可放心；占兄弟病父兴兄静病回生；占奴婢病财安子发无他事

rule.yi: 按病人和占卜人的关系分六首：子占父病，鬼要兴隆、父要安，兄动缠绵难脱体，子孙兴、财发就入黄泉；父占子病，兄兴子旺死里逃生，鬼摇父动终难保，财动病反增；夫占妻病，财明子动便安然，鬼爻发动更沉重，父发兄摇妻亡；妻占夫病，鬼静财兴可放心，兄弟交重恩义绝，父摇难愈；占兄弟病，父兴兄静病回生，鬼摇财动是黄泉客，子动躺几天；占奴婢病，鬼摇更缠绵，财安子发无事，父动兄兴不再生。
rule.en: Six poems divided by the relation between the sick person and the diviner. A son divining a father's illness: the ghost must thrive and Resource must be at peace; Peer moving, it drags on and is hard to shake off; Output rising and Wealth moving, it enters the Yellow Springs. A father divining a son's illness: Peer rising and Output strong, he dies and yet lives; the ghost shaking and Resource moving, in the end he cannot be kept; Wealth moving, the illness grows the more. A husband divining his wife's illness: Wealth clear and Output moving, at once she is at ease; the Pressure line moving, it grows heavier still; Resource issuing and Peer shaking, surely the string is cut. A wife divining her husband's illness: the ghost still and Wealth rising, one may set the heart at rest; Peer crossing heavily, love and duty are cut; Resource shaking, hard to cure. Divining a brother's illness: Resource rising and Peer still, the illness turns and he lives; the ghost shaking and Wealth moving, a guest of the Yellow Springs; Output moving, he lingers several days in bed. Divining a servant's illness: the ghost shaking, it drags on the more; Wealth at peace and Output issuing, no other matter; Resource moving and Peer rising, he does not live again.

yi: 凭经验总结的、家里人占病的歌诀：
子占父母的病，什么时候能好？
en: Verses from experience on divining the illness of a family member:
for a son divining a father's illness the verse runs:
A son divining a parent's illness, when will it be cured?
the ghost must thrive and Resource must be at peace;
Peer moving, it drags on and is hard to shake off;
Output rising and Wealth moving, it enters the Yellow Springs.

yi: 父亲占子女的病，歌诀是：
子病，亲人来问卦，问的是缘由：
财动，绵绵不断，病反而加重。
en: for a father divining a son's illness the verse runs:
A child ill, a parent comes to ask the hexagram for the cause:
Peer rising and Output strong, one dies and yet lives;
the ghost shaking and Resource moving, in the end he cannot be kept;
Wealth moving, on and on, the illness grows the more.

yi: 丈夫占妻子的病，歌诀是：
父发、兄摇，一定断弦（妻亡）。
en: for a husband divining his wife's illness the verse runs:
A husband asking of his wife's illness that has arisen:
Wealth clear and Output moving, at once she is at ease;
the Pressure line moving, it grows heavier still;
Resource issuing and Peer shaking, surely the string is cut (the wife dies).

yi: 妻子占丈夫的病，歌诀是：
妻子问丈夫的病，还不安宁：
en: for a wife divining her husband's illness the verse runs:
A wife asking of her husband's illness, still unsettled:
the ghost still and Wealth rising, one may set the heart at rest;
Peer crossing heavily, love and duty are cut;
Resource shaking, hard to cure, the illness deep.

yi: 父兴、兄静，病回过来活了；
鬼摇、财动，是黄泉的客人；
en: for divining a brother's illness the verse runs:
When a brother comes to divine an illness that clings:
Resource rising and Peer still, the illness turns and he lives;
the ghost shaking and Wealth moving, a guest of the Yellow Springs;
Output moving, it lingers several days in bed.
for divining a servant's illness the verse runs:
A servant lingering in an illness that clings:
the ghost shaking, the illness drags on the more;
Wealth at peace and Output issuing, no other matter;
Resource moving and Peer rising, he does not live again.

dispute.yi: 这一组和阐奥歌章那一组（LY.ILL.CA.07）有两处是意思不同的句子，其余是同义换字。一、子占父母病：阐奥歌章「子要兴隆父要安」（子孙兴旺、父母安静），这里「鬼要兴隆父要安」（官鬼兴旺、父母安静），两句差一个字、意思相反，书里没有说明；二、妻占夫病：阐奥歌章「兄子交重恩义绝」（兄和子孙都发动），这里「兄弟交重恩义绝」（兄弟发动）。别的只是同义换字：「问卦灵」和「问卦因」、「子动」和「子旺」、「缠绵」和「绵绵」、「增」和「添」、「疾病煎」和「疾病生」、「还沉重」和「加沉重」、「自安全」和「病回生」、「不得痊」和「不再生」。
dispute.en: This set and that of the Chan'ao Gezhang (LY.ILL.CA.07) differ in two places in sense, and the rest are synonyms swapped. One, a son divining a parent's illness: the Chan'ao Gezhang has 'Output must thrive and Resource must be at peace' (Output flourishing and Resource still), this has 'the ghost must thrive and Resource must be at peace' (the Pressure line flourishing and Resource still); the two differ by one character and are opposite in sense, and the book does not explain it. Two, a wife divining her husband's illness: the Chan'ao Gezhang has 'Peer and Output crossing heavily, love and duty are cut' (Peer and Output both moving), this has 'Peer crossing heavily, love and duty are cut' (Peer moving). The others are only synonyms swapped: 'asking the hexagram whether it is efficacious' and 'asking the hexagram for the cause', 'Output moving' and 'Output strong', 'drags on' in two words, 'increases' and 'adds', 'the illness that torments' and 'the illness that has arisen', 'still heavy' and 'heavier', 'of itself safe' and 'the illness turns and he lives', 'no recovery' and 'he does not live again'.

note.yi: 这六首和阐奥歌章的六亲占病歌（LY.ILL.CA.07）是同一组，字句有几处不同。「断弦」是妻子去世的委婉说法（琴弦断了）；「黄泉客」是死亡；「财明」是财爻明显出现。第一首的第二句是「鬼要兴隆父要安」，阐奥歌章是「子要兴隆父要安」，见「打架」。用爻表是：子占父母看父母、父占子看子孙、夫占妻看财、妻占夫看鬼（见 LY.ILL.TXF.01）。「占兄弟病」的「兄弟」是兄弟这个亲人，不是兄弟爻。
note.en: These six are the same set as the poems of the Chan'ao Gezhang for divining illness by relations (LY.ILL.CA.07), with several differences in wording. 'Duan xian' (the string cut) is a delicate way of saying the wife has died (a broken zither string); 'guest of the Yellow Springs' is death; 'Wealth clear' is the Wealth line clearly appearing. The second line of the first poem is 'the ghost must thrive and Resource must be at peace', where the Chan'ao Gezhang has 'Output must thrive and Resource must be at peace', see the dispute. The table of the Subject line: a son about a parent looks at Resource, a parent about a child at Output, a husband about a wife at Wealth, a wife about a husband at the ghost (see LY.ILL.TXF.01). The 'brother' of 'divining a brother's illness' is a brother as a relative and not the Peer line.
